chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abu Yahya al-Wasiti, from one of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Indeed, for Allah, Blessed and Exalted, there is a wind called Al-Azyeb. If He were to send from it the measure of the nostril of a bull, it would stir up what is between the sky and the earth, and this is the South (wind).

key_terms.الْأَزْيَبُ: A specific name for a powerful wind, identified here as the South wind.
key_terms.الْجَنُوبُ: The South, referring to the direction from which this specific wind blows.
key_terms.رِيحاً: Wind, in the context of divine creation and natural phenomena.
key_terms.مِنْخِرِ ثَوْرٍ: The nostril of a bull, used here as a measure of quantity to illustrate the potency of the wind.

ai.seo_question: What is the wind called Al-Azyeb and what is its power according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies the South wind (Al-Janub) as the divine wind known as Al-Azyeb, highlighting its immense potential energy. He illustrates its power by stating that a volume equivalent to the nostril of a bull would be sufficient to stir up everything between the heavens and the earth, emphasizing Allah's absolute control over natural forces. This description serves as a sign of divine majesty and is often linked to the winds mentioned in the Quran as instruments of Allah's will.

en.hubeali: H 14713 – Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Abu Yahya Al-Wasity, from one of our companions, who have narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws said:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High has a Wind which is called ‘Al-Azeyb). If He<sup>azwj</sup> Sends from it the measurement (which comes out of) the nostril of a bull, it would raise what is in between the sky and the earth, and this is (known as) the South (Wind)’.
en.sarwar: 265. Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Abu Yahya Al-Wasity, from one of our companions, who have narrated the following: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) said:

‘Allah (azwj) Blessed and High has a Wind which is called ‘Al-Azeyb). If He (azwj) Sends from it the measurement (which comes out of) the nostril of a bull, it would raise what is in between the sky and the earth, and this is (known as) the South (Wind)’.
